export_t5_to_executorch: export a t5-small model to ExecuTorch format using optimum-cli with the xnnpack recipe
run_t5_translation: run English to German translation using flan-t5-small loaded via ExecuTorchModelForSeq2SeqLM
run_t5_summarization: run text summarization using t5-small loaded via ExecuTorchModelForSeq2SeqLM with the xnnpack recipe
load_t5_model: load a pretrained T5 model for text2text generation using ExecuTorchModelForSeq2SeqLM.from_pretrained
test_t5_portable_recipe: test T5 translation and summarization using the portable recipe with executorch version 0.7.0 or higher
